item.description: A Utopian city insipired by Circuits I was recently in New York. What an amazing city! I was walking on the streets of Manhattan, and I realized how efficient the city is. I was stunned by architecure, the busy vibe and ofcourse, all the beautiful women. Note that I call the city efficeint. Its a strange way to describe a city. Infact, it almost felt like the city has life. One quick walk from the central park to the Macys store made me realize that cities do have life.
